title: Are you Team ABO or CBO? LMK in the comments!
description: Are you Team ABO or CBO? LMK in the comments!
transcript: Why I prefer using Abo versus CBO for my creative testing. So the way that I set up my creative testing on meta tends to look like this. For testing, you have one campaign and I'm using Abo and every single test is segmented by an ad set. And each of these tests is gonna have anywhere between 10 to 20 ads. Like I might do 20 for a statics batch or an AI creative batch, while I'll tend to do somewhere between 10 to 12 for creator content, for example, like this partnership ads, ads at. And I do tend to segment these by creative type, not necessarily creative angle. And here's why I tend to use Abo. I know many of you are gonna disagree. No.1, this is going to keep things more consolidated in the long run, which I do think is really important. Now in CPO, you tend to let your asset tests run forever. So you could have 50 or more assets in a single campaign, which I have seen degrade results over time. And at least with Abo, it lets you test things quicker, get a read on them and turn them off if they're not profitable. In my opinion, I really do feel like having a ton of assets in a campaign is kind of like the 2022 version of having too many campaigns. You're still not consolidated essentially. And because of this, I've seen Abo actually reveal more creative winners and Learnings over time, CBO will essentially push spend where there is more scale certainty, which oftentimes is going to be creative that has already been proven to win and also has a build up of social proof. Now this isn't to say that I never use CBO or I view CBO as some big red flag because I don't. I'm actually gonna be starting my own brand soon and I am using CBO for those campaigns. However, for brands that are really consistent with their creative output and they are spending more than 50 k, 75 k, hundred k per month, I really, really do recommend that they shift to Abo for that reason. Let me know in the comments if you are Team Abo or CBO.
